workspaceId.description: ID of the Microsoft Fabric workspace that holds the item the Spark session runs for, in lowercase.

itemId.description: ID of the Fabric item the Spark session runs for, in lowercase: the notebook or Spark Job Definition that started it, or the lakehouse a Livy API session or batch runs against. A notebook run from another notebook reports the outer notebook, because both run in the same session.

itemType.description: Type of that item, as Fabric names it in the session's settings, for example SynapseNotebook, SparkJobDefinition or Lakehouse.

livyId.description: ID of the Livy session that runs the Spark application, in lowercase. Fabric's Livy session list and run history key runs on it. A retried Spark Job Definition gets a new Livy session for each attempt.

jobInstanceId.description: ID of the Fabric job instance the session belongs to, in lowercase. All attempts of one Spark Job Definition run share it.
